subject: Discovery follow-up + exec alignment (VP/CTO intro) to unblock next steps

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Quick follow-up + exec alignment (VP/CTO intro)

Hi John —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary use case: customer support triage + summarization for 5M monthly interactions.
- Target latency: 150–300ms p50 on short responses, heavier batch jobs overnight.
- Ok with a hybrid model (hosted for dev, private/dedicated for production).
- Key success metrics: latency SLOs, per-token cost, audit logs retention for 7 years.

Next steps I proposed on the call:
1) Executive alignment (VP/CTO intro) to confirm procurement and security timelines — this will unblock the pilot.
2) Technical deep dive/demo (30–45 min) with our solutions engineer to walk through autoscaling, KV cache, and quantization profiles.

John — would you be able to introduce your CTO (or would you like me to invite yours)? I’ve copied Vivek (SE) here so he can join the technical session.

Proposed windows (ET):
- Wed 30 Jun: 10:00–10:45am or 2:00–2:45pm
- Thu 1 Jul: 11:00–11:45am

If those don’t work, feel free to grab a slot on my calendly: https://calendly.com/marissa-cole/30min

Attaching a short overview deck we referenced.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning execs and getting a pilot scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
